request.question: Select the single best primary handler for this request.

options.description: data_pipeline: Handles CSV ingestion, database exports, and scheduled transformations.
desktop_support: Handles Excel installation, licensing, add-ins, and OS file associations.
finance_review: Checks accounting assumptions and financial model correctness.
office_file_repair: Inspects and repairs XLSX ZIP/XML relationships, content types, styles, and corrupted workbook packages while preserving recoverable content.
spreadsheet_formula: Handles formula logic, pivots, cell values, and ordinary workbook calculations when the file opens normally.
